details:
Key highlights:
- JWT authentication, role-based access, seller approval, and immutable audit logs
- Nested categories, product variants, full-text search, and atomic stock control

name: Stremars : Full-Stack Video Sharing Platform
description: Developed a full-stack video-sharing platform inspired by YouTube, where users can explore videos without signing in and create accounts to upload videos, like content, comment, subscribe to channels and publish community posts.
details:
Key Features:
• Video upload, viewing, search, filtering, and publishing controls
• User authentication with access and refresh tokens
• Public creator profiles with cover images and recent videos
• Like, comment, subscription, and watch-history systems
• Community text posts with reactions
• Creator dashboard and channel management
• MongoDB-backed subscriber and reaction counts
• Cloudinary video, thumbnail, avatar, and cover storage
• React frontend bundled with Express for single Render deployment
• Health-check endpoint and responsive YouTube-style interface


Built the frontend with React and bundled it inside the Node.js backend for single-service deployment. Implemented JWT authentication, MongoDB-based watch history, real-time like and subscription toggles, public channel profiles, video search and filtering, Cloudinary media storage, and responsive user interfaces.
